what: Abbreviate country/flag names for compact display — abbreviate_flagname
title: Abbreviate country/flag names for compact display — abbreviate_flagname
text: Converts full country names short, conventional forms suitable tight spaces (facet strips, table columns, legends). Known acronym-style exceptions (e.g. "Federated states micronesia" "FSM") handled via manual lookup, checked first. Names lookup fall back general rules: trailing "..., Kingdom " / "..., Republic " style suffixes dropped, "Islands" abbreviated ".". Anything matching neither returned trimmed otherwise unchanged.

code: abbreviate_flagname(country_name)

title: Add Pacific Statistical Region Lines to a Map — add_statistical_region
text: plot ggplot object add region lines , built plot_pacific(). type Character string indicating region set add. One : "wcpfc" Western Central Pacific Fisheries Commission Convention Area. "wcpo_epo" Western-Central Pacific Ocean Eastern Pacific Ocean split, separated 150°W meridian. "npo_spo" North Pacific Ocean South Pacific Ocean split, separated equator. "nx_sx" Northern Southern regions within WCPFC Convention Area, separated equator west WCPFC boundary. "wcpfc_epo" Overlay WCPFC Convention Area WCPO/EPO split. Colours can customised using colour1 colour2. colour1 Colour used first region map types support colour customisation. Defaults "red". colour2 Colour used second region map types support colour customisation. Defaults "blue". shading Logical. TRUE, shade region(s) relevant type. plot type shares one colour across multiple sub-regions (e.g. "nx_sx"), union shaded single area. alpha Shading transparency. Defaults 0.2.

what: Calculate logbook reporting coverage against ACE catch estimates — calculate_logbook_coverage
title: Calculate logbook reporting coverage against ACE catch estimates — calculate_logbook_coverage
text: Compares logbook-reported catch ACE (aggregated catch estimate) catch flag/gear/species/year strata, calculates proportional shortfall logbook catch relative ACE catch.

title: Calculate logbook reporting coverage against ACE catch estimates — calculate_logbook_coverage
code: calculate_logbook_coverage(   in_wcpfc = TRUE,   year = NULL,   flag = NULL,   gear = c("P", "S", "L", "T"),   species = NULL,   exclude_flag = NULL,   exclude_gear = NULL,   exclude_species = NULL,   group_species = TRUE )

title: Calculate logbook reporting coverage against ACE catch estimates — calculate_logbook_coverage
text: in_wcpfc Optional logical. NULL, restricts sum_ace() "WX" ocean code passed logbook_catch() WCPFC-area filter; NULL, ocean filter applied. year Optional numeric vector years filter . flag Optional character vector flag codes filter . gear Optional character vector gear codes filter (passed logbook_catch(); sum_ace() filtered gear). species Optional character vector species codes filter . group_species Logical. TRUE, catch summed across species within remaining grouping (.e. SP_CODE dropped summarising). Defaults FALSE.

title: Calculate logbook reporting coverage against ACE catch estimates — calculate_logbook_coverage
text: tibble ace_catch, logbook_catch, coverage ((ace_catch - logbook_catch) / ace_catch) flag, year, species (unless group_species = TRUE), gear.

title: Calculate logbook reporting coverage against ACE catch estimates — calculate_logbook_coverage
text: ace_catch obtained via get_ace() logbook_catch via get_logbook_catch(), using flag/gear/species/year filters. two full_join()ed strata present one source retained, missing catch values filled zero via tidyr::replace_na(). group_species = TRUE, logbook_catch re-summed across species (SP_CODE dropped grouping); coverage column calculated proportional difference ACE logbook catch.

title: Calculate logbook reporting coverage against ACE catch estimates — calculate_logbook_coverage

what: Create Pacific Ocean Region Maps — plot_region_lines
title: Create Pacific Ocean Region Maps — plot_region_lines
text: Generates predefined Pacific Ocean map region boundaries labels. map type specified type, type corresponding particular combination lines text annotations.

title: Create Pacific Ocean Region Maps — plot_region_lines
code: plot_region_lines(   type,   colour1 = "red",   colour2 = "blue",   shading = FALSE,   alpha = 0.2 )

title: Create Pacific Ocean Region Maps — plot_region_lines
text: type Character string indicating map produce. One : "wcpfc" Western Central Pacific Fisheries Commission Convention Area. "wcpo_epo" Western-Central Pacific Ocean Eastern Pacific Ocean split, separated 150°W meridian. "npo_spo" North Pacific Ocean South Pacific Ocean split, separated equator. "nx_sx" Northern Southern regions within WCPFC Convention Area, separated equator west WCPFC boundary. "wcpfc_epo" Overlay WCPFC Convention Area WCPO/EPO split. Colours can customised using colour1 colour2. colour1 Colour used first region map types support colour customisation. Defaults "red". colour2 Colour used second region map types support colour customisation. Defaults "blue". shading Logical. TRUE, shade region(s) relevant type. plot type shares one colour across multiple sub-regions (e.g. "nx_sx"), union shaded single area. alpha Shading transparency. Defaults 0.2.

title: Create Pacific Ocean Region Maps — plot_region_lines
text: ggplot object showing requested Pacific Ocean region map.
